Lemma
[wedge constructions satisfy Bianchi] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0110, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0111 ↗ def:chow-ii-bianchi-map ↗ def:chow-ii-symmetric-endomorphism-wedge 1. ch11:11.13\group Algebraic Curvature Operators If $A\in S^2(E)$, then both $A\wedge \operatorname {id}$ and $A\wedge A$ belong to $\mathcal A_n$.
Proof

\sketch Substitute the component formula of 3 into the cyclic sum defining $b$. Every term cancels with the term obtained by the symmetry of $A$, both for $B=\operatorname {id}$ and for $B=A$.

□
